outcome: prevalence of SARS-CoV-2 infection in parturient women
prevalence of SARS-CoV-2 antibodies in parturient women
prevalence of SARS-CoV-2 antibodies in newborns
maternal hospitalisation due to COVID-19 during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 953 women with singleton pregnancies giving live birth in Denmark during the first wave of COVID-19 (May to November 2020).
finding: Maternal SARS-CoV-2 antibodies were associated with antibodies in cord blood, loss of smell, and a positive SARS-CoV-2 swab during pregnancy, but not with any adverse pregnancy outcomes.
